description: Extends the org preset like every other DFE consumer. Local-only: ignoreDeps holds two crates on scalo's line until scalo moves first - cel <0.14 because scalo's compiled cel::Program crosses the boundary, and opentelemetry-proto <0.32 because each proto minor pulls its own opentelemetry and opentelemetry_sdk, so a newer one puts a second otel stack in the graph. The third-party/ manifests are vendored Vector code whose only local edits detach it from Vector's workspace (third-party/README.md), so Renovate does not rewrite their floors; the workspace lock still moves what they resolve to.
